condition.title: Appeal agent read-only egress
condition.description: Permit only read-only, non-destructive, closed-world MCP operations; mutation and open-world operations remain outside the allow condition.
condition.expression: api.getAttribute('iap.googleapis.com/mcp.tool.isReadOnly', false) == true && api.getAttribute('iap.googleapis.com/mcp.tool.isDestructive', true) == false && api.getAttribute('iap.googleapis.com/mcp.tool.isOpenWorld', true) == false
